wb-daily-packaging.objective: Package the proven server WB daily collector chain reproducibly in the repository.
acceptance: Collection, norm and brief run strictly sequentially; any failure stops downstream work and preserves a machine-readable failure status.
Reentrant process is rejected by a file lock; timeout stops only the owned container. Every subprocess has a timeout.
Configuration contains paths, tenant, immutable image IDs and git revision, never secret values. Credentials are mounted read-only into only the stage that needs them.
Successful status requires yesterday Moscow for data and brief, stale=false, brief status ok; require 14 of 14 norm days.
Daily timer is 05:30 Europe/Moscow, Persistent=true; two retry attempts at 15-minute intervals. Units pass systemd-analyze verify.

Use current runtime reference as behavior baseline; export import-safe run_daily(config,execute=subprocess.run) returning status; CLI --config loads JSON and returns nonzero on failure. No live calls in tests. Exactly one scoped commit.

Config JSON keys: tenant_id, runtime_root, state_root, collector_image, control_image, git_sha, network, database_container. run_daily(config, execute=subprocess.run) returns a status dict with state success/failed; tests may inject execute. No work on import.

source_evidence.summary: Proven server reference serializes collect, norm and brief; uses a nonblocking file lock, per-subprocess timeouts, immutable image and git identities, private logs, and verifies yesterday Moscow plus stale=false and brief status ok. Package this behavior behind the accepted configurable run_daily interface; do not copy tenant names, secret names or installation paths.
The proven reference has 14 tests covering the runtime chain. Repository tests must remain offline and reproduce the accepted behavior contract.

wb-warehouse-metadata.objective: Make historical WB overlap replay tolerate warehouseName-only changes without corrupting immutable facts or evidence.
acceptance: For the same tenant,srid,lastChangeDate, persisted and incoming payloads differing ONLY in existing string warehouseName are treated as replay, retaining prior row, prior full payload and prior canonical hash.
New raw artifacts remain evidence of the incoming response. Do not rewrite old hashes/payloads; do not merely exclude the field from new hashes, since that breaks legacy compatibility.
Changed numeric financial fields, dates, cancellation, identifier or any other field still raises WB_SCHEMA_DRIFT and rolls back observations.
Missing/null/non-string warehouseName on either side does not qualify for the exception. Sales rows keep strict existing comparison.
Real PostgreSQL tests cover legacy hashes, replay, tenant boundary, mixed metadata+financial drift and batch boundaries. Exactly one scoped commit.

source_evidence.summary: Baseline canonicalizes every order and sale payload, hashes it, and rejects any same natural-key plus lastChangeDate row with a different canonical hash before insert. The approved exception is orders only, warehouseName only, both values existing strings; retain the stored legacy payload and hash while raw incoming evidence remains. All other drift and all sales stay strict.

wb-daily-status.objective: Provide a small truthful read-only projection of the real daily WB collector status for Director.
acceptance: Import-safe pure project_daily_status(snapshot,now_utc) returns only tenant_id,state,analyzed_day,collected_at,last_attempt_at,reason_code; no credentials, raw errors or arbitrary payload fields.

Completed collector snapshot succeeds only if state success, stale exactly false, last_full_day and brief_day equal yesterday Moscow, brief_status ok, norm sample_days/window_days 14/14, and timestamps are valid and not in the future.
Failure/running/missing/invalid/old snapshots cannot claim readiness; failures show fixed reason codes, not untrusted error messages.
Read-only adapter reads at most 64KiB JSON; missing file and invalid JSON become unavailable. Never runs a subprocess or writes a file.
Fixture tests cover success, stale data, midnight Moscow, missing keys, malformed/future timestamps, failure and attempted secret-field injection. Exactly one scoped commit.

source_evidence.summary: The real daily status snapshot has running, success and failed states and verified fields for last_full_day, stale, collected_at, brief_day, brief_status, actual and norm. The projection must expose only the accepted six safe fields, calculate yesterday in Europe/Moscow, validate 14/14 norm coverage and never pass through raw errors or credentials.
